# What the preview publishes, one path per line, relative to the repo root.
#
# Not the whole repository: GitHub Pages serves at most 1GB per site and the
# tree here is over 3GB — the home pages carry ~150MB of assets each. So a
# preview names the pages the current work is about, and stays small enough
# that every branch's preview can sit alongside the others.
#
# Blank lines and lines starting with # are ignored.

# This branch is the design-system pass over every page, so what goes up is a
# page for each thing the pass touched:
#
#   the Axopar brand page — the About section, its cards and its two panels
#   the office page       — the listing card and the How can we help? band
#   locations             — the band and the footer these two came from
#   the listing page      — the Other Listings rail, the third card family
#   terms                 — a page that is nothing but a header and a footer
#   the team page         — the band on a page of photographs
#   all services          — the band and footer on a long page
#
# 72MB between them.
pages/Jeff Brown Yachts - Brand Page (Axopar)
pages/Jeff Brown Yachts - Office Page
pages/Jeff Brown Yachts - Locations Page
pages/Jeff Brown Yachts - Listing Page
pages/Jeff Brown Yachts - Terms Page
pages/Jeff Brown Yachts - Team Page
pages/Jeff Brown Yachts - All Services Page

# What is NOT here, and why: the home page (~95MB) and the search prototype
# (~150MB), which is what this manifest held until now.
#
# gh-pages is at ~786MB before this branch adds anything — five preview folders
# from other branches, four of them for work already merged into this one. The
# guard below stops the build at 900, so 245MB of home page and search does not
# fit and has not fitted for two days: every run on this branch since
# 2026-09-21 has failed on that guard, and previews/publish-all has never
# existed. Nothing was lost by dropping them, because nothing was ever there.
#
# Both come back the moment the merged branches' preview folders are cleared
# off gh-pages — previews/feat-contact-us-layout, previews/feat-intro-logo-v3
# and previews/feat-mega-menu-brand-models are all merged into publish/all and
# are the obvious ones to go. That is a decision about links other people may
# be holding, so it is not one to take quietly in a manifest.
